body:
Follow-up objective: improve Google relevance for exact query `ktappdev` without falsely replacing the site's personal brand, Ken Taylor.
Context: Scout verified `ktappdev` currently appears only in Twitter metadata, JSON-LD alternateName/sameAs, and links. Homepage title/H1/description/visible body say only Ken Taylor. The user wants the site to be discoverable when searching `ktappdev`.
Action steps:
1. Inspect AGENTS.md, src/pages/index.astro, src/layouts/Layout.astro, src/lib/site.ts, and existing styles/copy.
2. Make the smallest natural, accessible homepage copy change that visibly associates Ken Taylor with ktappdev (for example, a short existing hero/subtitle/footer line; do not add keyword stuffing or duplicate text).
3. If the homepage SEO title or description has a clearly safe existing prop/source, include `ktappdev` there while retaining Ken Taylor. Do not change every page or create a keywords meta tag.
4. Run pnpm build and git diff --check.
5. Review diff for visual/copy regressions.
Constraints: Minimal diff; no new dependencies; no speculative Organization schema; no external registration work.
Deliverables: changed files, exact copy added, validation results. Reply via picode_send.
